title: Deleting a ZIA rule label
aliases: label still associated with a policy rule

help-delete-constraint.statement: The help text states that a rule label can be deleted only if it is not associated with any policy rule.

quotes: You can delete a rule label only if it's not associated with any policy rule.

terraform-delete-detaches-firewall-rules.statement: Destroying `zia_rule_labels` first strips the label from Cloud Firewall filtering rules only, then deletes the label; rules of other types that still hold it are not touched by the provider.

quotes: if _, err := rule_labels.Delete(ctx, service, id); err != nil {

referenced-label-delete-api.title: What the API does when a label that rules still reference is deleted
referenced-label-delete-api.blocks: saying whether a Terraform destroy fails or leaves a dangling reference when a non-firewall rule still holds the label
referenced-label-delete-api.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Attempting to delete a label that is still referenced returns an error from the API... it will surface as a Terraform apply-time error if a zia_rule_labels resource is destroyed while any rule resource still holds a reference to it." The help text states the constraint for the console only; no registered source shows the API error. The related open question for groups is [[zia.terraform.delete-detach:in-use-enforcement]]. In a scratch tenant, attach a label to a URL filtering rule, delete the label by API, then re-read the rule.
